I want to call out two scheduling constraints on our side that affect the proposed week:
- Our Solutions Architect (Tessa) is traveling the week of 6/9 for an enterprise workshop — limited availability for deep demo Q&A.
- We just received word that several Beacon programs are subject to a short FY reprioritization window; finance has signaled a temporary capex hold until the rebaseline (sounds like a Q2→Q3 timing shift).

Given that, can we do the following so we don't burn cycles?
1) Put the interactive exec-level walkthrough on hold for the week of 6/9–6/13.
2) I can provide a short recorded walkthrough and an MT summary this week for stakeholders to review asynchronously.
3) If Beacon prefers a live session, propose we target the week of 7/7 when Tessa is back and we should have more clarity on Beacon's budget window.

I've attached a draft Mutual Action Plan to start capturing next steps (attachment stub: Beacon_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx). If you want to keep it active, I'll mark 'paused — awaiting CFO budget baseline' in the MAP so procurement has visibility.

Next steps: let me know if you want the recording now or prefer to wait for a live slot in early July.

Thanks — Karthik
